It declares the project’s own GitHub repository as the source, builds it with Meson, installs files into $pkgdir, and renames the installed binary. The VCS checksum being set to SKIP is expected for a Git source and is not evidence of malicious behavior. There are no network requests, no code execution, no data exignment, no obfuscation, and no suspicious patterns. This is a legitimate, well-structured AUR package configuration that follows established best practices.
